facts.fact: Organic Law No. 2024-22 of 11 March 2024, published in JORT No. 37 of 12 March 2024, amends and completes Law No. 93-27 of 22 March 1993 on the national identity card, issued by the Ministry of Interior; an organic law promulgated by the President.
facts.system: Law No. 93-27 of 1993 on the national identity card, as amended by Organic Law No. 2024-22 of 2024

facts.fact: Organic Law No. 2024-22 of 2024 provides that the identity card carries an encrypted secure electronic chip holding the card number and fingerprint and photo, and an electronic certificate allowing identity verification and electronic signature; it leaves the card model to a decree and the certificate rules to a joint ministerial order, with no such instrument dated in the document.
